Class CollectionService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.BaseService
      • io.milvus.v2.service.collection.CollectionService

      • createCollection

        public Void createCollection(MilvusServiceGrpc.MilvusServiceBlockingStub blockingStub,
                             CreateCollectionReq request)
        Creates a collection. When a collectionSchema is provided the collection is created from the schema; otherwise a simple schema is built from the request parameters. An index is created on the vector field and the collection is loaded afterwards.
        Parameters:
        blockingStub - the gRPC blocking stub
        request - the create collection request
        Returns:
        null

        public Void createCollectionWithSchema(MilvusServiceGrpc.MilvusServiceBlockingStub blockingStub,
                                       CreateCollectionReq request)

        Parameters:
